value.rationale: The prism and K_{3,3} are precisely the two nonisomorphic connected cubic simple graphs on six vertices (their complements are respectively C_6 or two disjoint triangles). Full-symmetry quotient topology for K_{3,3} was already computed, while the prism case was not covered. Together the two results classify this first small natural cubic-graph family, and the distinction S^4 wedge S^4 versus S^4 shows how group-orbit homotopy detects graph structure not determined by matching six vertices, nine edges, rank-five graphic matroids, or shellability. An octahedral comparison further shows why integral and pi1 checks carry genuine mathematical content.
